title: 第1574章 没人迎接那就撞过去第1573章 果然陛下的眼光就是高
slug: 自缚禁地五百年我当散修你哭啥
content_zh:
事实上宋辞舟的猜测确实成真了。
因为就在宋辞舟开口没有回应的时候，此时此刻，就在他们上方一层的平台边，几道身影正一边玩味地看着他们，一边通过秘法传音交流：
“那就是所谓的人皇？看上去细皮嫩肉的，怕是都扛不住一拳。”
“据说才七阶修为，圣城是真的没人了。”
“方才公孙戟怎么把他们就这么放进来了，按规矩不是应该先杀杀威风，至少在他们进城之前，先弄伤一半吗？”
“谁知道呢，我们按照计划来就行，先晾着他们，让他们就在这干等个半天再说，好好挫一挫他们的锐气，让他们知道这凛冬城可不是他们的三垣圣城！”
“……”
这几人是北君钦点的，负责接待圣城使团的官员。
他们不光是接待那么简单，接下来和圣城的一系列谈判，也都需要他们应对。
为了避免之后被动，他们选择了最干脆利落的方法。
先把圣城使团的锐气给打磨打磨。
毕竟饿的只能听话的狗，总比会龇牙的狼要更好打发。
不过也有人面露担忧：“温大人，我们……这么做是不是有些太过了，那毕竟是三垣圣城，来的还是三垣人皇，我们如此怠慢，会不会……不太好啊？”
被称作温大人的是一名宫装女子，方才还正面露冷笑的打量着顾修。
听到这话的时候忍不住皱了皱眉。
好在，也不用她说什么，旁边自然有人帮自己呵斥这不懂事的人。
“这有什么不好的，圣城怎么了，人皇又怎么了，来了我们凛冬城，是龙是虎都得给我乖乖盘着卧着！”
“就是，以前的圣城确实万众一心，但如今的圣城算什么？一个七阶修士就当人皇了，这圣城你以为还跟以前一样能让人信服不成？”
“这群人可是奔着极寒冰魄来的，不好好打磨打磨这些人的锐气，到时候他们狮子大开口怎么办？”
对自己同伴的斥责，那开口之人倒也没敢反驳，只是犹豫了下提醒道：“北君要求的，是让我们把人带上去参见北君，现在我们这么晾着他们，万一耽误了北君的事怎么办？”

这话一出，众人齐齐一窒。
有点不敢开口了。
北君在凛冬城，那就是天，那就是绝对的主宰，他们可以不怕人皇，但没有人不畏惧北君。
要真耽误了北君的大事，他们所有人都承担不起后果。
“哼，你们以为，北君会在乎他们不成？”
温姓女子却在此刻哼笑一声：
“北君确实让我们接他们前往拜见，但可没说要不要第一时间带人去拜见北君。
更没说，我们不能在领人参拜之前，先好好挫一挫他们的锐气。”
这话一出，众人松了口气。
确实是这个道理。
虽说其实有点牵强，但想到温大人是北君如今的宠妾，她这么说，必定是北君的意思，众人也倒不会没脑子的去反驳。
不过，那之前开口提醒之人，此刻还是难免有些忧愁：“可公孙戟不可能平白无故就这么快把人放进来，现在这情况已经出乎预料，我们是不是该谨慎一些？”
“有什么可谨慎的，这都已经在凛冬城了，难不成他们还敢在城内出手不成，这可是坏规矩的事。”
“他们若真的敢如此，我们就算把他们杀得只剩下一个人皇，就算是老天师也绝对不敢多说一个字。”
“可是……”
content_en:
In fact, Song Cizhou's guess did come true.
Because just when Song Cizhou opened his mouth without responding, at this moment, on the platform one floor above them, several figures were looking at them playfully while communicating through secret sound transmission:
"Is that the so-called Human Emperor? He looks so thin and tender that he might not even be able to withstand a punch."
"It is said that with only the seventh level of cultivation, there is really no one left in the Holy City."
"Why did Gongsun Ji just let them in like this? According to the rules, shouldn't we kill Wei Feng first and at least injure half of them before they enter the city?"
"Who knows, let's just follow the plan. Let them wait here for a long time and let them know that this Winter City is not their Three Walls Holy City!"
"..."
These people were appointed by Beijun and were responsible for receiving the officials from the Holy City mission.
They are not only as simple as reception, but they also need to deal with the subsequent series of negotiations with the Holy City.
In order to avoid being passive later, they chose the most straightforward method.
First, polish the spirit of the Holy City Mission.
After all, a hungry dog ​​that can only obey is better to deal with than a wolf that can show its teeth.
However, some people expressed concern: "Master Wen, are we... not doing this a little too much? After all, this is the Holy City of Sanyuan, and it is the Human Emperor of Sanyuan who is here. If we are so negligent, will it... not be good?"
The person called Lord Wen was a woman in palace attire, and she was looking at Gu Xiu with a sneer just now.
I couldn't help but frown when I heard this.
Fortunately, she didn't need to say anything, there were naturally people nearby to help her scold this ignorant person.
"What's wrong with this? What happened to the Holy City, and what happened to the Human Emperor? When they come to our Winter City, be it a dragon or a tiger, they have to lie down in the cross-legged position for me!"
"That's right, the Holy City in the past was indeed united, but what is the Holy City today? A seventh-level monk has become the Human Emperor. Do you think this Holy City can still be as convincing as before?"
"This group of people came here for the extreme cold and ice soul. If we don't polish the spirit of these people, what will they do when the time comes?"
In response to his companion's rebuke, the person who spoke did not dare to refute. He just hesitated and reminded: "Beijun asked us to bring people up to see Beijun. Now that we are leaving them alone, what if Beijun's affairs are delayed?"
As soon as these words came out, everyone was suffocated.
I was a little afraid to speak.
Beijun is in Winter City, that is the sky, that is the absolute master. They may not be afraid of the Human Emperor, but no one is not afraid of Beijun.
If they really delayed Beijun's important event, none of them could afford the consequences.
"Hmph, do you think Beijun cares about them?"
The woman surnamed Wen laughed at this moment:
"Beijun did ask us to pick them up to meet him, but he didn't say whether we would take people to see him immediately.
Not to mention, we can’t dampen people’s spirits before leading them to worship. "
As soon as these words came out, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
This is indeed the truth.
Although it is actually a bit far-fetched, considering that Lord Wen is Beijun's current concubine, what she said must be Beijun's intention, and everyone would not mindlessly refute it.
However, the person who warned him before was still a little worried at this moment: "But Gongsun Ji can't let people in so quickly without any reason. Now this situation is unexpected, shouldn't we be more cautious?"
"There is nothing to be cautious about. This is already in Winter City. How could they still dare to take action in the city? This is a bad rule."
"If they really dare to do this, even if we kill them until there is only one Human Emperor left, even the old Heavenly Master will never dare to say another word."
"But..."
